degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering Degree in Chemical Engineering

description.text: Note: The specialty is conducted in English with a prerequisite of a minimum number of 15 students . Before applying, pls contact SICAS for the latest information. Teaching Objectives Comprehensive development of physical and moral training to adapt to the contemporary needs of the development of chemical engineering. Basic theory, skills and research methods of chemical engineering will be carried out. After four-year education, the students should have the ability to serve the fundamental industry with modern scientific technology of chemistry and engineering, be able to do scientific research, product and process design, technical administration and so on. Research Fields Chemical Engineering Process Polymer Material and Chemistry New Chemical Material and Energy Resources Fine Chemicals Chemical Reaction Engineering Industrial Catalysis Main Courses Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry Physical Chemistry Basic Chemical Equipment Mechanical Chemical Reaction Engineering Chemical Technology Industrial Catalysis Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering Degree in Chemical Engineering

duration.text: The Chemical Engineering at China University of Petroleum (Huadong) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
